verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms an llms.txt file is served at https://docs.slack.dev/llms.txt (HTTP 200) with a description framing the docs as covering 'apps, agents, workflows,' i.e. agent-oriented documentation, and Slack's docs site is structured with clear developer/agent-facing sections (MCP server, CLI, Web/Events APIs). Missing for 10: independent/community confirmation that agents successfully consume this llms.txt in practice, and no OpenAPI spec is exposed (all candidate paths 404) which would further strengthen machine-readability.
